skills.name: Kaioken
skills.description: Permanent transform. Costs 20 HP (1st-2nd use) / 40 HP (3rd+ use), 1 Random (1st use) / 2 Random (every use after). 1st use: Kamehameha +20 Dmg permanently, unlocks Kaioken Attack. Every use: Kaioken Attack damage increases. | 1 Rand

effects.description_template: {value} Piercing Dmg (ignores dmg reduction) | 1 Rage, 1 Mar

effects.new_description: Permanent transform (active). Each further use costs 20 HP (2nd use) / 40 HP (3rd+ use) and increases Kaioken Attack damage. | 2 Rand

skills.notes: Permanent, repeatable transformation -- not a temporary buff. Each use: costs HP (escalating, see schedule below), and on the very first use it permanently boosts Kamehameha +20 dmg and unlocks Kaioken Attack. Every use (including the first) also re-scales Kaioken Attack's damage upward. No cooldown: the escalating self-damage is the only limiter, by design -- Goku can use this as many times as he wants, even to his death.

skills.name: Kaioken Attack
skills.description: Locked until Kaioken is used. 40 Piercing Dmg, +10 per further Kaioken use | 1 Rage, 1 Mar
skills.locked_reason: Kaioken Attack requires Kaioken to be used first!
